messages:
ryan: hi all, ryan here, first day! trying to run `kubectl get svc -n infra-monitoring` but getting `Forbidden`. i think my kubeconfig context isn't set up for redwood clusters. who should i contact to get access?

sam (infra): welcome @ryan :wave: i'll help. do `kubectl config get-contexts` and paste the current-context. also what's your SSO email? we do group-based RBAC.

ryan: current-context is `docker-desktop`. sso email ryan.p@redwood.ai. i only need view and occasional port-forward.

jen (devex): FYI onboarding doc has step for switching contexts and pointing at our clusters. https://redwood.internal/onboarding/k8s-quickstart

sam (infra): thanks. i'll add you to `dev-k8s-developers` and create a temp RoleBinding for port-forward if you need it. creating ticket now.

ops-bot: INFRA-1108 created by sam: "Onboard ryan.p: add to dev-k8s-developers and temp binding for infra-monitoring". ETA: 20m.

sam (infra): quick hint: after i add the group, you may need to refresh your SSO token. run `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev` and then `gcloud auth login` or follow SSO popup. also if kubeconfig points to docker-desktop switch contexts to avoid hitting local cluster.

ryan: switched to `redwood-dev` and re-authing.

sam (infra): applied view RoleBinding in namespace infra-monitoring and added group mapping. try `kubectl auth can-i get svc -n infra-monitoring`.

ryan: `kubectl auth can-i` returns yes and `kubectl get svc -n infra-monitoring` lists services now. nice! thanks.

jen (devex): added reminder to onboarding checklist to check current-context and SSO refresh on first day. small UX win.

ryan: appreciate the quick help. who can do a 10min intro to the monitoring namespace layout later?

sam (infra): ping me after lunch, i'll show common deployment names and port-forward tips.

ryan: great, will do. thanks everyone!
